subject: Kestrel Health — Access orchestration & SSO/SCIM preflight
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@kestrelhealth.com>; Kestrel Security <security@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kestrel Health — Access orchestration & SSO/SCIM preflight

Hi Lena (and Kestrel security team),

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Kestrel onboarded. To make the implementation window as smooth as possible, can you please share the items below before our technical test window (suggested: 2027-09-29):

1) IdP / SAML: complete IdP metadata XML (entityID, singleSignOnService, signing cert). If you cannot share metadata, list ACS and Audience URIs and the cert thumbprint.
2) SCIM: attribute mapping expectations (username/email attribute, externalId usage), and whether you want group provisioning (automatically create/update groups).
3) IP allowlist: public egress ranges (CIDR) we should add to Redwood's allowlist for API callbacks and webhook health checks.
4) Service accounts: list of service accounts that need persistent impersonation (names, scopes). We prefer the naming pattern: redwood-svc-<team>-<purpose>.
5) Org policies: any enforcement rules (SAML mandatory, SSO enforcement for all users, MFA exceptions for service accounts, retention flags).
6) Test users: 2-3 accounts with different role levels we can use for end-to-end verification (one admin, one standard, one read-only).

I've attached an onboarding matrix to capture the above and the proposed mutual action plan. Once we have these, we'll:
- Create a dedicated staging connector in your tenancy
- Provision SCIM mapping and run an initial sync (read-only)
- Execute a controlled SSO test and group provisioning verification
- Schedule a canary cutover with rollback steps

Notes on compliance: we will need a point-of-contact for SOC2 evidence requests during the onboarding window; security@kestrelhealth.com looks like the right address — please confirm.

Attachments: kestrel-onboarding-matrix.xlsx (matrix + MAP), mutual action plan link in Drive.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kestrel Security <security@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Health — Access orchestration & SSO/SCIM preflight

Grace,

Thanks — attaching the IdP metadata (kestrel-idp-metadata.xml). Quick answers inline below and in the attached filled matrix.

- IdP/SAML: attaching metadata; our ACS is https://accounts.kestrelhealth.com/sso/acs and entityID is https://idp.kestrelhealth.com. We sign assertions; cert included.
- SCIM: yes to group provisioning. Primary username attribute is user.email. We also rely on externalId for cross-system continuity. We want the following attributes synced: givenName, familyName, title, managerEmail, department.
- IP allowlist: our egress ranges are 54.230.128.0/18 and 18.205.32.0/20 (AWS-managed NAT in us-west-2).
- Service accounts: we have two service accounts used by automation: automation-jenkins and infra-deployer. We are open to renaming to your suggested pattern if needed.
- Org policies: SSO enforced for managed employees; service accounts are exempt from MFA but must use certificate-based auth.
- Test users: provided in the matrix (admin: lena.admin@kestrelhealth.com, standard: rick.user@kestrelhealth.com).

Timeline: we can be ready for a staging test 2027-09-29 between 09:00-12:00 PT. Security team will join for the SAML assertion validation.

Attachments: kestrel-idp-metadata.xml, completed-onboarding-matrix.xlsx

Lena Ortiz
Product Security Lead, Kestrel Health
lena.ortiz@kestrelhealth.com
+1 (619) 555-0199

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-23T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel Health — Access orchestration & SSO/SCIM preflight

Hi Lena — received, thank you. Confirming the staging test window: 2027-09-29 09:00-12:00 PT.

Next steps on our side:
- Monica (cc'd) will drive SCIM attribute mapping and perform the initial read-only sync on 9/27 in our staging tenant.
- Ben (cc'd) will request allowlist exceptions for the listed CIDRs and validate webhook routes.
- We'll provision two temporary service accounts following the redwood-svc-<team>-<purpose> pattern: redwood-svc-kestrel-automation, redwood-svc-kestrel-deployer. Please confirm if you need us to retain your original names (automation-jenkins) for audit mappings — we can set externalId aliasing.

Can you confirm the following before 9/27:
- Preferred service account naming or alias instructions
- Which SCIM groups should map to roles inside Redwood (e.g., Kestrel-Admins -> admin, Kestrel-ReadOnly -> viewer)
- Who from your security team will be the point for certificate/Assertion signing troubleshooting during the window (name + phone)

I attached a short preflight guide that covers our canary rollback process and a proposed runbook skeleton (redwood-sso-scim-preflight.pdf). We'll also create the HubSpot deal activity and a ticket in our implementation queue (HUBSPOT-12488).

On the canary plan: we'll run a group sync for a single test group first, validate attribute fidelity and account mappings, then do a full sync after signoff. If assertions fail, we will automatically fall back to username/password for the small test cohort and open an incident for root cause.

Thanks — Monica, can you pick a time on 9/27 to perform the sync? Ben, please raise the allowlist change request and attach the ticket link in the mutual action plan.

Best,
Grace

--

Please update HUBSPOT-12488 with the checklist items and close any gaps by EOD 9/27. I'll be the escalation contact during the staging window and will join the 9/29 test.
